The '''Claymore''' is a [[Weapons#Sword|sword weapon]] that can be purchased from the [[Adventurer's Guild]] for {{Price|2000}} after reaching floor 45 in [[The Mines]]. It is a possible reward for the chest on floor 80 of the Mines if "remixed" mine rewards are selected in the [[Options|Advanced Options]] menu when starting a new game.

==History==
{{History|1.5|Level lowered from 6 to 5 and sell price lowered from {{Price|300}} to {{Price|250}}.  Bug where weapon defense had no effect fixed.}}
